anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential CPU bottleneck or overload.
AI system has not performed any recent learning cycles, generated opportunities, or made adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading metrics show zero activity (totalPL, activeTrades, winRate, roi), which may indicate issues with trading strategy execution or market conditions.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially update AI models and strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and effectively.
Assess and refine active trading strategies to improve engagement and performance metrics.

recommendations.action: Address the high CPU load immediately by identifying and mitigating the processes causing the overload.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, slow performance, and potential downtime, which is critical for a trading platform.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of AI system operations to identify and resolve any issues preventing learning cycles and opportunity generation.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform competitiveness.

recommendations.action: Evaluate the performance of current trading strategies and make necessary adjustments to improve trading metrics.
recommendations.rationale: Improving trading strategy performance can enhance profitability and user satisfaction.
